detail.longDescription: I'm building a web server using rust and actix-web. I want to make sure that user uploaded image are valid and safe to serve to other users. When I use actix-multipart::form::bytes::Bytes I get a content_type field but reading docs this is just the value of the Content-Type HTTP header which I shouldn't blindly trust as it can be manipulated by a bad actor. I think just inferring the image type from magic bytes is not enough. A user may upload image files that target a vulnerability in a decoder.
